headline: Bitcoin Funding Turns Negative At 0.0018 Percent After A Positive 0.0035 Percent Reading
narrative: Bitcoin perpetual funding turned negative at 0.0018 percent after a positive 0.0035 percent reading. The funding reset reads crowded short, which means the latest reading is squeeze fuel, not a top, while the recent average remains positive at 0.0017 percent. Ether funding stayed positive at 0.0082 percent and Solana funding stayed positive at 0.0013 percent, so the sign change is in bitcoin perps, not across the complex.
